title: White-Haired Warrior Poses
description: Four nearly identical side-by-side panels show a dark-skinned female character with long flowing white hair in a dynamic pose. She wears a red sleeveless coat with silver embellishments, red gloves, black pants, and red boots against a dark textured background with faint red script.
prompt: A dark-skinned woman with long flowing white hair is captured in four side-by-side panels wearing a sleeveless deep red fantasy coat with silver details, red gloves, black cropped pants, and red boots. She stands in a dynamic combat pose with one hand raised and the coat flowing dramatically. Dark textured background with faint red script elements, consistent lighting across all four views, digital character illustration style.
